title: Viewport-priority legend sampling and 'announce mode' for low-fidelity time-series interactions
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: High-density time-series charts (10k+ points) currently generate too many legend rows and dense tooltip payloads which overload DOM, hurt interactive latency, and produce noisy screen-reader output. Goals: 1) Introduce a viewport-priority sampling strategy for legend and tooltip representation so we only create UI elements for the most relevant series in the visible range; 2) Add an optional ARIA 'announce mode' that emits compressed verbal summaries for screen readers (e.g. top-3 trends, anomalies, and a short summary line) instead of raw point-by-point reads; 3) Maintain visual fidelity for users who need full-resolution data while improving performance for the common case.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Default chart rendering with 10k points and 200 series must have interactive first-response < 220ms on macOS M1 and < 300ms on midrange Linux VM (measured via Console telemetry). 2) Legend DOM nodes created for viewport should be <= min(30, number of series in viewport) by default and configurable. 3) Tooltip payloads for dense views must return compressed summaries under 2KB. 4) 'Announce mode' passes automated screen-reader smoke tests (VoiceOver + NVDA) with no more than 3 verbal items for primary summary. 5) Feature has design spec, dev API, and e2e test on console-2026.04 branch.
design_notes: - Sampling heuristic: weight series by visual prominence (line opacity * max delta in viewport) + recency of interaction. - Legend priority pipeline: 1) viewport membership, 2) prominence, 3) user pinned series. Pinned series always appear. 4) Remaining series are aggregated into an 'Other (N)' collapsed row with a lightweight sparkline. - Tooltip behaviour: in dense mode show a compact summary card (percentiles, peak timestamp, recent slope) and an optional 'expand' to full table when user requests. - Announce mode: produce an accessible summary sentence like 'In the last hour, revenue increased by 12% with a notable spike at 09:14.' followed by up to two trend lines. Provide a developer API to supply custom summary templates for enterprise customers. - Visual fallback: maintain canvas rendering for >5k points; use SVG for small series sets to support semantic events and CSS theming. - Config knobs: maxLegendItems, tooltipMode (full|compact|summary), announceMode (on|off|auto).
tradeoffs_and_risks: - Reducing legend items may hide low-priority series for power users; mitigated by pin/unpin UX and a discoverable 'show all' option. - Summarized tooltips may obscure exact numeric values; mitigated by explicit expand control. - Announce mode requires careful natural language phrasing to avoid introducing bias; implement A/B preview and tests with real screen-reader users. - Performance gains depend on server/client telemetry; conservative defaults recommended.
